title: ssh: Fix with gcrypt < 1.7.0 (CentOS 7, SLES 12)
description:
Recent commits 2874b979ada0c7111c0b4a5a c1870203041251095a877cdbc6
7356889242e790b1c0ed, a2f6b079f16e0dfa10a1eab82b have lines that
need to be protected by ifdef guards when SSH_DECRYPTION_SUPPORTED
isn't defined. (gcrypt < 1.7.0)

Fixes build.
